question: Where was Śiva wandering while moving here and there in the cosmos?
premises: Śiva was wandering here and there.
The wandering occurred within a specific locus.
That locus is the middle of the three-world wheel.
inference: Śiva wandered through the center of the wheel of the three worlds.
plain_english: Wandering here and there, he moved within the middle of the wheel of the three worlds.
